query: So if people get violent during strikes, what happens to them?
reference_answer:
Violence during Bandhs or Strikes:
Violence during bandhs or strikes can lead to imprisonment up to 3 years and/or a fine, under the IPC Section 307 (attempt to murder) or Section 325 (grievous hurt).
answer: If people get violent during strikes, they can face legal consequences such as fines, imprisonment, or being banned from future strikes. [System]
